brief:
Pro-Israel group StopAntisemitism has launched voting for its "2026 Antisemite of the Year" award, Eye on Palestine reported. The list targets prominent Palestinian rights advocates, including New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and his wife, artist Rama Duwaji, along with Spanish figures.

The group's voting initiative places activists and public figures who support Palestinian causes alongside others on a list the organization uses to highlight what it characterizes as antisemitism.

title: Pro-Israel group names Palestinian rights advocates in antisemitism award voting
